goal: Test whether KINETIC can transfer a browse-first dark gallery grammar to an original V0 on a new reference, without copying source implementation, branding, copy, fonts, media, or assets.
core_concept: A compact motion catalogue where each original preview is a signal tile inside a disciplined browse shell; the page teaches the collection through consistent frames, not through source-specific content.

sections: utility bar with brand-neutral title, primary links, search affordance, and theme control
left navigation rail with grouped catalogue filters and a mobile menu entry point
central browse heading with a short original introduction and result metadata
filter toolbar with labeled search and category controls
responsive preview shelf of original CSS-generated signal tiles with compact metadata
right support rail containing original documentation and contribution panels
return-to-top control after the catalogue shelf
composition_plan.spatial_system: Desktop uses a top utility bar over three columns: narrow left rail, flexible central shelf, narrow right rail. The central shelf owns the visual weight; rails are independently legible but subordinate. At smaller widths rails collapse and the shelf reduces to two then one column.
composition_plan.visual_hierarchy: The display heading establishes the page thesis, the filter toolbar frames the browse task, preview tiles are the dominant repeated unit, and metadata/support content remains quiet.
composition_plan.pacing: Use regular card bands for browse rhythm, with one short intro before the shelf and one quiet end-of-list return action; avoid Wanaka-style long editorial chapter pacing.
composition_plan.density: Dense catalogue in the center with stable gutters and generous internal card padding; rails are compact but never overlap the browse surface.
focal_points: display heading with a small gradient signal mark

typography_plan.display_role: Bold system sans-serif display heading with a restrained italic emphasis on the second word; original copy only.
typography_plan.body_role: Readable system sans-serif for navigation, card metadata, helper text, and controls.
typography_plan.scale_strategy: Use clamp-based display and body sizes with four explicit roles: display, section, label, metadata; keep card titles short and readable.
typography_plan.contrast_strategy: Bright text for task hierarchy, muted gray for metadata, and uppercase tracking only for labels; no source font files or source typography names.
typography_plan.rhythm: Tight title-to-metadata pairing inside cards, medium control spacing, and larger section gaps between intro, toolbar, shelf, and support content.
typography_plan.responsive_behavior: Display heading and rail labels reduce at narrow widths; card metadata remains readable and never relies on clipped text.

art_direction.imagery_strategy: No external imagery. Each tile uses an original CSS-generated abstract signal motif that communicates a motion category without depicting source media.
art_direction.asset_strategy: Inline HTML/CSS only; no external URLs, images, videos, icons, fonts, or library code.
art_direction.texture: Subtle grid, grain-like radial gradients, and thin borders are generated with CSS backgrounds; avoid copied preview artwork.
art_direction.material: Charcoal panels with soft inset edges and luminous gradient accents; surfaces are layered but restrained.
art_direction.depth: Depth comes from panel separation, a shallow hover lift, and an inner focus ring rather than persistent 3D or WebGL.
art_direction.layering: Top bar, rails, shelf, preview motif, signal badge, and focus ring occupy explicit z-levels; no full-screen overlay is permitted.
art_direction.color_logic: Near-black and charcoal form the shell, soft white and muted gray carry hierarchy, and violet/magenta/blue gradients are localized to signal previews and primary actions.

signature_move.name: signal constellation
signature_move.central_idea: The active preview tile reveals a short constellation trace that links its abstract signal to the tile's metadata, making browsing feel like selecting a live instrument rather than opening a static card.
signature_move.trigger: pointer hover or keyboard focus on any preview tile
signature_move.visual_transformation: The preview motif shifts upward slightly, its inner signal ring scales to identity, and a small accent trace fades into place while the metadata remains stable.
signature_move.purpose: Connect the user's browse action to the preview's category without adding unrelated ambient animation across the page.
signature_move.content_relationship: The trace is attached to the selected tile's signal motif and category label; it is not a decorative global effect.
signature_move.reduced_motion_alternative: Keep the tile fully opaque and show a static focus ring plus accent trace with no transform or transition.
signature_move.capture_checkpoint: desktop signature hover/focus after a stable 1200ms checkpoint; mobile content state with keyboard-equivalent focus

scroll_storyboard: initial: utility bar, intro heading, first shelf row, and quiet rails establish the browse task
mid-scroll: repeated preview bands and right support panels maintain even catalogue pacing
signature: focused tile exposes the signal constellation while neighboring tiles remain stable
final: last shelf row and return control resolve the page without a conventional full-width footer
transitions: use duration-slow and easing-out-expo for preview reveal and focus transformation
use duration-med and easing-out-quint for filter/result changes
use opacity-hidden/opacity-visible and distance-reveal-y for one-time section reveals
disable all motion and smooth scrolling under prefers-reduced-motion
interaction_states: search filters cards by original title/category and updates the result count
category select filters the shelf without navigation
theme control toggles an original light token set
mobile menu exposes the left rail without a blocking overlay
tile hover and keyboard focus share the signal constellation state
return control moves focus back to the page heading
motion_plan.reduced_motion_behavior: The reduced-motion media query removes transitions and transforms, sets reveal content to its resting state, and changes scroll behavior to auto. All controls remain usable.

retained_principles: separate browse/navigation/support rails so the central catalogue remains dominant
use a stable repeated preview frame for varied interactive content
concentrate luminous gradients on previews and primary actions
make one focused interaction explain the purpose of a preview
deliberately_rejected_principles: Wanaka's editorial studio narrative and irregular portfolio pacing
source-specific labels, component names, branding, or promotional copy
source implementation details, library code, preview media, or exact geometry
persistent ambient animation that would increase cost without improving browse comprehension
prohibited_copying: React Bits source code or component implementations
React Bits branding, logos, copy, typography, demo media, or assets
exact section geometry, card artwork, labels, or source CSS values
any standalone or bundled redistribution of source components

design_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited, unused React Bits reference only for abstract browse-shell, catalogue, and motion-preview observations in this controlled generalization.
knowledge_used: dark application shell separates a left navigation rail, central gallery, and right support rail
repeated rounded preview panels with compact metadata make a large catalogue browseable
violet, magenta, and electric-blue gradients are concentrated in previews and primary actions
search, category filtering, theme/preferences, and card focus states are explicit browse affordances
preview motion is observed as an interaction intent only; exact timing and implementation remain unclaimed

composition_differences: Use a fictional signal catalogue and original six-zone page structure rather than a source documentation index.
Use a compact central shelf with original support content and CSS-only preview motifs; do not reproduce source card geometry or labels.
Collapse rails with a custom mobile menu and keep the return control inside the original shell.
typography_differences: Use system font stacks and original title/metadata roles rather than source font identity or copy.
Use a restrained italic emphasis and custom scale ratios suited to the fictional catalogue.
motion_differences: Implement one CSS-token-driven signal constellation interaction with a static reduced-motion path.
Use one-time section reveals and no persistent source-like preview animation loop.
originality_plan.asset_non_reuse: All candidate visuals are authored with CSS gradients and HTML geometry; there are no external asset, font, media, icon, or source-code dependencies.
originality_plan.signature_move_hypothesis: A focused tile should communicate category and browseability through one localized constellation trace, preserving the source's interaction intent while remaining compositionally and technically original.

quality_hypothesis: A disciplined dark catalogue shell with localized motion, clear controls, and restrained card repetition should test generalization beyond Wanaka while avoiding the prior failure mode of plain, under-animated originals. Human fidelity review must determine whether the transfer is actually understood; no quality or taste qualification is inferred.
